## Acceptance criteria

All REQ-01–REQ-10 are met. The prompt defines tagged, individual-patch attribution; fallback behavior; impact cones; blocking/advisory verdict rules; concise style; and distinct leaf/container review behavior in [scripts/doc-review-prompt.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/scripts/doc-review-prompt.md:11). The configured gate consistently uses that prompt in [.jit/gates.toml](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.jit/gates.toml:127).

## Architecture and correctness

The classification fields are pure domain data with backwards-compatible deserialization in [gate_findings.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/domain/gate_findings.rs:44), storage round-trips them in [gate_runs.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/gate_runs.rs:39), and CLI rendering remains in [main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:793). No layer-boundary, atomic-write, event-log, PID-safety, or unsafe-code regression found.

## Testing

Recorded cargo-ci passed: fmt and clippy clean; 3,551 tests passed, 0 failed. The earlier cargo-ci attempt failed before tests ran because its temporary directory was read-only; the later successful run resolved that environment issue. I did not rerun cargo tests. `./scripts/jit-validate.sh` passed.

Regression coverage verifies prompt policy and container semantics in [doc_review_policy_test.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/tests/doc_review_policy_test.rs:12), plus parsing, JSON output, advisory passing results, and compatibility in [gate_findings_test.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/tests/gate_findings_test.rs:107).

## Error handling, CLI, and documentation

No new fallible paths were added. Existing `--json` gate output preserves both classifications. Public domain APIs retain doc comments and examples. No prior review findings were supplied, and the issue has no dependencies.
